meta.notes: A instrument tag gives one name to several instrument ids. values lists ids or other tags (written #namespace:path); set replace to true only to wipe what other packs put in a tag of the same id. The set_instrument loot function picks a random call from a tag such as #msm_examples:calm_horns; goats drop a horn from #minecraft:regular_goat_horns, or #minecraft:screaming_goat_horns when they scream.
